name: OFM-NeoPixel
description: OFM-NeoPixel is a high-performance, hardware-accelerated LED control library for the OpenKNX Framework, driving addressable RGB/RGBW/RGBCCT strips (PIO/DMA on RP2040/RP2350, RMT on ESP32-S3). Highlights: self-describing stateless effects, 2D/3D matrix geometry with topology-aware coordinate mapping, an Effektmanager cue sequencer (timed, chainable effect presets per segment), distributed cross-device rendering (Effektkette) where multiple KNX devices form one virtual LED band, per-strip power management and Human Centric Lighting (HCL).
keywords: LED, NeoPixel, WS2812, SK6812, APA102, RGBCCT, Power Management, HCL, Human Centric Lighting, 2D Matrix, 3D Matrix, Effektmanager, Cue Sequencer, Effektkette, Distributed Rendering, RP2040, RP2350, ESP32
